response: Large language models operate by processing text through a Transformer architecture, converting inputs into numerical tokens and utilizing self-attention mechanisms to predict the most statistically probable next token. System parameters and safety guidelines are integrated during pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to ensure responses remain accurate, safe, and helpful.
